templates.pattern: Pointing to [P1], [P2] says 'He is the son of my father's only son.' How is [P1] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: My father's only son = myself. So [P1] is the son of [P2]. [P1] is [P2]'s Son.

templates.pattern: [P1] is the brother of [P2]. [P2] is the sister of [P3]. [P3] is the son of [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1]-[P2] are siblings. [P2]-[P3] are siblings. [P3] is son of [P4]. So [P1] is also child of [P4]. [P4] is Parent of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] said 'This girl is the wife of the grandson of my mother.' How is [P1] related to the girl?
templates.explanation: My mother's grandson = my son or nephew. If it is [P1]'s son, the girl is [P1]'s daughter-in-law. Most direct = Father-in-law.

templates.pattern: [P1] is the father of [P2]. [P2] is the mother of [P3]. [P3] is the sister of [P4]. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P1] → father of [P2] → mother of [P3],[P4]. So [P1] is maternal grandfather of [P4].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the son of [P2]. [P2] is the sister of [P3]. [P3] is the mother of [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P2] and [P3] are sisters. [P1] is son of [P2], [P4] is child of [P3]. So [P1] and [P4] are cousins. [P4] is Cousin of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the mother of [P2]. [P2] has a brother [P3]. [P3]'s father is [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is mother of [P2]. [P3] is brother of [P2], so [P1] is also mother of [P3]. [P4] is father of [P3]. So [P4] is Husband of [P1].

templates.pattern: Pointing to [P1], [P2] says 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is [P2] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: Only daughter of my mother = myself ([P2]). So [P1]'s mother = [P2]. [P2] is Mother of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] is [P2]'s brother. [P3] is [P2]'s father. [P4] is [P3]'s father. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is sibling of [P2]. [P3] is father of [P2], so also father of [P1]. [P4] is father of [P3]. So [P4] is Grandfather of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] are married. [P1]'s sister is [P3]. [P3]'s husband is [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is husband of [P2]. [P3] is sister of [P1]. [P4] is husband of [P3]. So [P4] is Brother-in-law of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the daughter of [P2]. [P2] is the son of [P3]. [P3] is the father of [P4]. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P3] is father of both [P2] and [P4]. [P1] is daughter of [P2]. So [P1] is Niece of [P4].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the sister of [P2]. [P2] is the brother of [P3]. [P3] is the daughter of [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1],[P2],[P3] are siblings. [P3] is daughter of [P4]. So [P1] is also child of [P4]. [P4] is Parent of [P1].

templates.pattern: Pointing to [P1], [P2] says 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is [P1] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: My grandfather's only son = my father. [P1] is daughter of [P2]'s father. So [P1] is Sister of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the wife of [P2]. [P3] is the son of [P2]. [P4] is the brother of [P3]. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is wife of [P2]. [P3] and [P4] are sons of [P2]. So [P1] is Mother of [P4].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the uncle of [P2]. [P2] is the brother of [P3]. [P3]'s mother is [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is uncle of [P2] and [P3]. [P4] is mother of [P3]. [P1] is brother of [P4]'s husband or [P4]'s brother. Most common = Sister-in-law.

templates.pattern: Introducing [P1], [P2] says 'He is the husband of the only daughter of my father-in-law.' How is [P1] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: My father-in-law's only daughter = my wife (or [P2] herself if female). Husband of [P2] = [P1]. So [P1] is Husband of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] is [P2]'s father. [P3] is [P1]'s sister. [P4] is [P3]'s mother. How is [P4] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: [P4] is mother of [P3] and [P1]. [P1] is father of [P2]. So [P4] is Paternal Great-grandmother of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the son of [P2]. [P2] has only one brother [P3]. [P3] has a daughter [P4]. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P2] and [P3] are siblings. [P1] is child of [P2], [P4] is child of [P3]. So [P1] and [P4] are Cousins.

templates.pattern: [P1] is the daughter of [P2]'s grandfather. [P2] has no siblings. How is [P2] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is daughter of [P2]'s grandfather = [P2]'s aunt (father's sister). So [P2] is Nephew/Niece of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] are a couple. [P3] is the son of [P1]. [P4] is the daughter of [P2]. [P3] and [P4] are siblings. How many children does the couple have?
templates.explanation: [P3] and [P4] are siblings and children of the couple. So they have 2 children.

templates.pattern: Pointing to a photo, [P1] says 'This man's son is my son's father.' Who is in the photo relative to [P1]?
templates.explanation: My son's father = myself ([P1]). So the man's son = [P1]. The man in photo is [P1]'s Father.

templates.pattern: [P1] is married to [P2]. [P1]'s mother is [P3]. [P4] is the brother of [P3]. How is [P4] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: [P4] is maternal uncle of [P1]. [P2] is wife of [P1]. So [P4] is Uncle-in-law of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] said 'The girl playing outside is the younger of the two daughters of the woman whose husband is my father's only son.' How is the girl related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: My father's only son = myself. My wife's daughters = my daughters. The girl is [P1]'s Daughter.

templates.pattern: [P1] is the brother of [P2]. [P3] is the father of [P2]. [P4] is the wife of [P3]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P3] is father of [P2] and [P1] (siblings). [P4] is wife of [P3]. So [P4] is Mother of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1]'s mother is [P2]. [P2]'s father is [P3]. [P3]'s wife is [P4]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P4] is wife of [P3], who is father of [P2], who is mother of [P1]. [P4] is Maternal Great-grandmother of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the son of [P2]. [P3] is the brother of [P2]. [P4] is the son of [P3]. How is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P2] and [P3] are siblings. [P1] is son of [P2], [P4] is son of [P3]. They are Cousins.
